pages.text: The $(item)Essence Infuser$() pours one of the three griefs into the vessel I leave in it.

pages.name: Essence Infuser
pages.text: 5 by 5 floor, a candle on each corner.

pages.title: Bound to Me
pages.text: At its third tier I bound it to myself, once my body carried an Essence Reserve. For as long as it stands, it sends 40 of each grief a second into me, wherever I am.
